full_judgment: 2. Brief facts are that the petitioner and the respondent Nos. 11-18. as plaintiffs, filed Title Suit No. 251 of 1999 in the Court of Joint District Judge. 41h Court Dhaka for partition on the averments that 59 decimals of land in C.S. Dag No.69 I appertaining to C.S. Khatian No.326 of Mouza Gopparh, P. S. Keraniganj, Dhaka belonged to Mohabbai Ali and 42 decimals of land in C. S. Dag Nos.806 and 810 appertaining to C.S. Khatian No.833 of Mouza Mondail of the same police station belonged to Sadek Ali Mia alias Saber Miah and Ali Box Bhuiya in equal shares; while they were possessing and enjoying of the same there was an exchange by which Saber Mia, the predecessor of the plaintiffs, got the aforesaid 59 decimals of land listed in C. S. Dag No. 691 and Mohabbat Ali got the aforesaid 42 decimals of land listed CA. Dag Nos. 806 and 810; Saber Mia, having no full brother, gave shelter to Sohrab Ali, the defendant, and also gave him 4 annas share by oral heba and S.A. record was prepared accordingly; Saber Mia while in possession of the suit land died leaving behind the plaintiffs as his heirs; the plaintiff is entitled to possess and enjoy their 12 annas shares in ejmali and the defendant is entitled to possess and enjoy his 4 annas shares; but the defendant having in his possession more land then he is entitled, the plaintiffs on 15.2.1983; reqbested him for partitioning the suit land but he did not comply and hence the suit. The defendant contested the suit by tiling written statement contending, inter alia, that the suit land belonged to Mohabbat Ali who, out of the same, gave patron of 30 decimals to Mokbul Ali; after the death of Mokbul Ali, his son, the defendant, and daughter Chan Bhanu got the above 30 decimals by inheritance; the plaintiffs collusive)/ got the S.A. Record prepared showing only 4 annas share in the share of the defendant instead of 30 decimals. The trial court, after considering the evidence and materials on record, decreed the suit. The defendant then preferred Title Appeal No. 459 of 2002 and filed therein an application praying for allowing them to produce some dakhilas as additional evidence and the plaintiff opposed - the said prayer. But the teamed Additional District Judge, after hearing, allowed the same. The plaintiff petitioner then moved the High Court Division and after hearing the High Court Division rejected the revisional application summarily.
